# langsmith_data_planes (Data Source)

Lists the hybrid/self-hosted data planes registered for the current organization.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "langsmith_data_planes" "all" {}

output "data_plane_names" {
  value = [for dp in data.langsmith_data_planes.all.data_planes : dp.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
